incident_description:
Impact Summary:
Between 20:22 UTC and 22:08 UTC on August 24, 2026, customers using Databricks on AWS in EU Central 1 may have experienced degraded availability with Lakebase. Affected customers may have been unable to create, access, or operate Lakebase databases and related workloads during this window.

Symptoms:
• Database creation and administrative operations failing to complete
• Connection failures or queries timing out against Lakebase databases
• Applications backed by Lakebase returning errors

Current Status:
The issue has been resolved, and all affected services have been restored.

Next Update:
This is the final update for this incident.

incident_name: EU West 1 - Multiple services (Partial Service Disruption)
incident_description:
Between 10:10 UTC and 13:00 UTC on August 6, 2026, a subset of customers using Databricks may have experienced failures or delays when starting Serverless Compute and Classic Compute resources, including SQL warehouses, as well as failures affecting Declarative Pipelines. Impact varied in severity and duration across the affected services during this window.

Symptoms
• Serverless SQL warehouses failed to start or experienced startup delays
• Classic compute SQL warehouses failed to start or experienced intermittent delays
• Declarative Pipelines experienced execution failures

Current Status
This incident has been resolved.

We apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused. If you require further details about this incident, please submit a support ticket or contact help@databricks.com.
